description: Estimate how much of an LLM context window your MCP servers consume, and which tool definitions to cut first. Paste your MCP config. Returns per-server token cost, remaining budget, and ranked reduction advice.

config.description: Your MCP config as JSON. Either {"mcpServers":{...}} or a raw {name:{...}} map. Each server may declare "tools":[{name,description,inputSchema}]. Accepts a JSON object, or a JSON string containing one.

reservedForConversation.description: Tokens you want to keep for the actual conversation (default 40000)

name: estimate_mcp_context_budget
